claim: The International Multiple Sclerosis Genetics Consortium is an external collaborative network producing MS genetics publications and resources; some outputs are open publications while some underlying genotype datasets use controlled access routes.
future_grounding_route: Specific IMSGC loci, summary statistics, or controlled datasets can be queued for project grounding only after access, licensing, and reproducible input provenance are established.
project_use: Competitor/source cataloging and genetics prior-art context.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Consortium-scale MS genetics publication corpus and controlled/open genetics resources beyond this repository's held data.
why_unverifiable: The project cannot rerun the consortium's full cohort assembly, genotype access, or publication-level analyses from this repository.
